steps.title: Kill the Royal Titans until you …
steps.text: Kill the Royal Titans until you get the Deadeye prayer scroll and Mystic vigour prayer scroll. — Ideally do this on a Fire Giants or Ice Giants Slayer task. — The Zombie Axe and defender is slightly better dps here if you have it, but isn't worth grinding just for this fight. — It also puts your Magic attack bonus slightly below 70 if you are using an imbued Slayer Helm. — You should take almost no damage in this fight once you learn it, but learner can take some extra food. — Minigame teleport to Clan Wars to re-gear.
